pass_condition: Prove an admitted unfiltered distance/sample lower bound with useful finite-N onset and calibration costs, or a legal trace-distance counterexample. Charge state preparation/routing and filter success; Gaussian covariance matching alone is insufficient.
priority_rationale: Universal binary survival can rely on exp(-cN) output filtering; the exact GAD fixture defeats the simple covariance condition. It gives neither a nonvanishing unfiltered margin nor an efficient general experiment.
question: For a fixed nonunital non-EA channel, does the engineered input retain a nonvanishing raw full-separability distance or a practical local test?
title: Decide unfiltered nonunital distinguishability and cost
validation_boundary: No gate is closed by indexing, agreement, finite diagnostics, or a newer timestamp; this is a routing decision, not predicted breakthrough value.
